title: Semantic, presentation and device boundaries
summary: Intention Service v0.1-dev11 resolves requested business operations; a viewer-authorized business provider supplies real objects; an ooRexx presentation controller orders AGENT, INVOICE, TPS_REPORT and PRODUCT scenes; Foreign Runtime invokes a native worker emitting I420 and PCM.
invariants: Intention resolution is not permission to disclose fields.
An actual report or invoice must be supplied by an authorised business provider; the LLM does not invent business state.
Presentation plans/scene metadata and media device frames are separate contracts.
ConnectSelector is optional and should follow its verified contract: direct call, standalone JSON-RPC and Queue Fabric remain alternatives.
Queue Fabric is not mandatory for media presentation.
procedure: Check the live business-provider API before binding scene models.
For production, require a short-lived session-bound presentation grant before rendering/sending content.
Keep decoding adapters replaceable without turning them into a competing ooRexx Foreign Runtime.

provenance.claim: Separation of Intention, business records, presentation controller and native output.
Actual help desk and NotNotes API used in dev2 fixture.
